After any single play with the exact ticket price, C leaves pot() equal to 0 exactly when the win-branch condition (keccak256(timestamp,difficulty) % 2 == 0) holds and equal to TICKET_AMOUNT otherwise; the mutant (mod 1) always wins and always zeroes pot, violating the rule whenever the hash modulo 2 is 1.
The contract's ether balance always equals its recorded pot after a play.
